The claim 'An account without an email address is accepted' is a broad architectural/security claim that requires more than just a passing test result to be considered a reusable memory rule. The observation is insufficient to prove the causal claim without additional context about whether this is intended behavior or a bug that the test happens to pass (e.g., if the test explicitly checks for optional email, it doesn't prove the system accepts it generally).
